changes: Added PHP-free serve-only mode for load balancers, using a standalone Go frontend as the sole HTTP listener.
Removed HTTP nginx and PHP-FPM runtime dependencies from serve-only nodes while preserving RTMP, supervisor, and CLI functionality.
Improved serve-only installation, capability detection, rollback, downgrade, and recovery behavior.
Added a root-owned node helper with restricted arguments and narrowly scoped sudo permissions.
Introduced signed and sealed per-node gateway policy replicas and XCVT v2 support for pinned load-balancer configurations.
Added portable transcoding specifications and runtime directives to reduce dependencies on MAIN-specific state.
Improved cluster node identity, activation-key persistence, admission handling, lifecycle recovery, and runtime reconciliation.
Improved recovery of missing stream runtime state, deleted-server enrollments, and persistent configuration drift.
Added gateway integration work for VOD, timeshift, subtitles, and thumbnails.
Added provider channel previews, source probing, and an optional Ministra playlist block.
Improved multilingual VOD series matching using normalized names and TMDb metadata.
Improved stream restart scheduling, segment handling, viewer statistics, and runtime recovery.
Hardened certificate synchronization with temporary files, restrictive permissions, validation, and atomic replacement.
Restricted privileged sysctl operations and node crontab changes to explicitly authorized operations.
Improved Ministra device binding, user-agent allowlists, reseller authorization, and serial-number guessing protection.
Fixed nginx port updates, duplicate listeners, configuration repair concurrency, and serve-only startup edge cases.
Improved dashboard active-user counts, reseller stream-client counts, administration menus, and EPG reload behavior.
Updated the required PHP version to 8.3 to match the shipped runtime.
Improved binary update handling, release artifact ordering, and nightly cleanup.
Added the Xtream Codes OpenAPI 3.1 reference and expanded documentation for PHP 8.3, cluster provisioning, serve-only load balancers, XCVT v2, and xcvm_core.
Expanded automated tests for serve-only provisioning, privilege boundaries, downgrade recovery, cluster behavior, and nginx configuration.
